title: 日常对话母体：120个可迁移话轮

design.language: 以通用日常英语为主，拼写以英式为主
design.sourceUsage: 原句、译文和迁移例句为本学习包新编；Oxford条目用于词头和短语对照。

BE.label: be 动词与状态问答
BE.note: 状态、身份、地点用 be；疑问句把 am/is/are/was/were 放到主语前。

PRES.label: 一般现在时与 do/does
PRES.note: 习惯用一般现在时；do/does 后面回到动词原形。

PAST.label: 一般过去时与 did
PAST.note: 过去的动作在肯定句用过去式；did/didn't 后用原形。

PROG.label: 现在进行时
PROG.note: am/is/are + V-ing，描述当前或现阶段正在做的事。

SUBJQ.label: 主语疑问句
SUBJQ.note: What happened? / Who called? 中疑问词本身作主语，通常不另加 did。

WH.label: 特殊疑问句
WH.note: 先选疑问词，再判断用 be、do/does/did 还是其他助动词。

THERE.label: there be 与存在
THERE.note: 有某物用 there is/are；与最近接或核心名词的数协调。

QUANT.label: 数量、可数与不可数
QUANT.note: how many/a few 接可数复数；how much/a little 常接不可数。

COMP.label: 比较与同等程度
COMP.note: 比较级 + than；as + 形容词原级 + as。

DEGREE.label: too/enough 与不定式
DEGREE.note: too + 形容词 + to V；形容词 + enough + to V。

INF.label: 不定式与想做某事
INF.note: want/need/would like/plan 等按各自结构接 to + 动词原形。

MODAL.label: 情态动词后的原形
MODAL.note: can/could/should/must/might 等之后不用第三人称 -s 或过去式。

POLITE.label: 委婉请求与 would you mind
POLITE.note: Could you + V?；Would you mind + V-ing?；注意是否在请求别人行动或征求自己行动许可。

IMP.label: 祈使句与提醒
IMP.note: 动词原形开头；否定用 Don't + 动词原形。

FUT.label: 将来计划、安排与临时决定
FUT.note: be going to 常表达计划；will 可作临时决定；现在进行时也可表达已安排的未来活动。

TIME.label: 时间从句
TIME.note: 谈未来时，when/as soon as 等从句通常用现在时，主句可用 will。

PASTPROG.label: 过去进行时与过去事件
PASTPROG.note: was/were + V-ing 提供背景，过去式交代插入或完成的事件。

PERF.label: 现在完成时：经历与结果
PERF.note: have/has + 过去分词；ever、already、yet 常帮助定位语气。

DURATION.label: for/since 与持续时间
DURATION.note: for 接一段时长；since 接起点；how long 询问持续多久。

PERFPROG.label: 现在完成进行时
PERFPROG.note: have/has been + V-ing，强调延续的活动或过程。

USED.label: used to / be used to / get used to
USED.note: used to + V 是过去习惯；be/get used to + 名词或 V-ing 是习惯于/逐渐习惯。

ING.label: 动名词与介词后的 V-ing
ING.note: enjoy/avoid/mind 等后常接 V-ing；介词后接动词时用 V-ing。

COND1.label: 真实条件与 unless/as long as
COND1.note: if/unless/as long as 引导未来条件时通常用现在时，主句表达后果。

COND2.label: 假设与委婉建议
COND2.note: if + 过去形式，主句 would + V；If I were you 是常见建议框架。

COND3.label: 对过去的反事实假设
COND3.note: if + had + 过去分词，主句 would/could have + 过去分词。

PASTPERF.label: 过去完成时
PASTPERF.note: had + 过去分词，把一件事放在另一过去时点之前。

PASSIVE.label: 被动表达
PASSIVE.note: be + 过去分词；现在进行被动是 am/is/are being + 过去分词。

MODPASS.label: 情态动词与被动
MODPASS.note: 情态动词 + be + 过去分词。

FUTPERF.label: 将来完成表达
FUTPERF.note: will have + 过去分词，表示到未来某个时点已经完成。

REPORTED.label: 转述与过去视角中的将来
REPORTED.note: said/told 后接内容；在过去视角中，will 常相应变为 would。

INDIRECT.label: 间接问句
INDIRECT.note: Do you know/Could you tell me + 疑问词 + 陈述语序。

REL.label: 定语从句与关系词
REL.note: who/that/which/whose 等修饰名词；作宾语的关系词在限定性从句里常可省略。

NOUNCL.label: 内容从句与 what 引导的名词性结构
NOUNCL.note: that/what 等后的内容可作宾语或主语；what 可表示‘所……的事’。

REASON.label: because 与 because of
REASON.note: because 后接完整句子；because of 后接名词短语或相应名词性结构。

CONTRAST.label: 让步与对比
CONTRAST.note: although/even though 后接从句；despite/in spite of 后接名词或 V-ing。

PURPOSE.label: 目的表达
PURPOSE.note: to/in order to + V；so that + 主语 + can/could 等表达目的。

COORD.label: 并列选择与 both/either/neither
COORD.note: 连接成分的语法形式保持平行；either…or… 表二选一。

TAG.label: 附加问句
TAG.note: 依据主句的助动词和肯否来构造尾部问句；语气随情境和语调变化。

DEDUCE.label: 推测与确定程度
DEDUCE.note: might 表可能；must/can't 可据线索表达较强的肯定/否定推断。

ADVICE.label: 建议、义务与必要性
ADVICE.note: should/had better/have to 的语气和形式不同，按实际关系选用。

DOUBLE.label: 双宾语与给谁什么
DOUBLE.note: send/give/show 等常用‘动词 + 人 + 东西’，也可按动词习惯用介词改写。

OBJCOMP.label: 宾语补充说明与 it 形式宾语
OBJCOMP.note: keep/make + 宾语 + 形容词补充说明对象；find it + 形容词 + to V 用 it 先占宾语位置。

PREFER.label: 偏好与 would rather
PREFER.note: prefer A to B；would rather + V；than 前后保持平行。

PRON.label: 人称、所属与互相
PRON.note: my/your/their、myself 等随人物变动；each other 表互相。

EXCL.label: 感叹与评价
EXCL.note: What + a/an + 形容词 + 单数可数名词；也可用普通陈述句表达评价。

FREQ.label: 频率与程度副词
FREQ.note: often/usually 等位置随 be 与实义动词结构调整；how often 询问频率。

POSSESS.label: 所属与 whose
POSSESS.note: whose 问归属，也可引导表示所属关系的定语从句。

PREP.label: 介词与时间、地点、路径
PREP.note: in/on/at、from/to 等配合所指时间、地点与路径使用。

SUGGEST.label: 提议与商量
SUGGEST.note: How about + 名词/V-ing；Why not + V；Let's + V。

REPAIR.label: 澄清、改口与确认
REPAIR.note: 重复、改说和确认都可用简短、礼貌的句式完成。

WISH.label: wish 与非现实愿望
WISH.note: wish + 过去形式可表达与现在现实有距离的愿望；祝愿某人时可用 wish + 人 + 名词短语。

SVC.label: 主系表与感受、外观
SVC.note: look/sound/seem/feel 等表示状态或感受时可接形容词；不要把它们的疑问句一律照 be 的词序构造。

scenes.title: 通勤出了什么事
scenes.goal: 问发生了什么，解释原因，再追问怎么解决。

lines.english: What happened on your way to work this morning?
lines.chinese: 你今天早上上班路上发生什么事了？
lines.frame: What happened 【时间／地点】?
lines.tip: what 本身作 happened 的主语，不加 did；若问‘你做了什么’，才是 What did you do?。

transfers.english: What happened during the meeting?
transfers.chinese: 开会期间发生什么事了？

transfers.english: What happened to your phone?
transfers.chinese: 你的手机怎么了？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: There was a traffic jam because of an accident near the station.
lines.chinese: 车站附近出了事故，所以堵车了。
lines.frame: There was 【一件事】 because of 【名词短语】.
lines.tip: because of 后面接名词短语；换成完整原因句，用 because。

transfers.english: There was a delay because of the rain.
transfers.chinese: 因为下雨，出现了延误。

transfers.english: There was a problem because of a mistake in the address.
transfers.chinese: 地址出了错，所以遇到了问题。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: How did you get to work in the end?
lines.chinese: 那你最后怎么到单位的？
lines.frame: How did 【人】 【动词原形】 in the end?
lines.tip: did 已标记过去，get 保持原形；不要说 did you got。

transfers.english: How did you fix the computer in the end?
transfers.chinese: 你最后怎么修好电脑的？

transfers.english: How did they choose the hotel in the end?
transfers.chinese: 他们最后怎么选定那家酒店的？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: I had to get off the bus and walk the rest of the way.
lines.chinese: 我只好下车，剩下的路走过去。
lines.frame: 【人】 had to 【动作原形】 and 【动作原形】.
lines.tip: had to 表过去不得不；get off 与 walk 都用原形，共享前面的 had to。

transfers.english: I had to change my plan and call the hotel.
transfers.chinese: 我只好改计划，再给酒店打电话。

transfers.english: We had to wait outside and try again later.
transfers.chinese: 我们只好在外面等，过会儿再试。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 聊早晨习惯
scenes.goal: 问时间和频率，练 do/does 与动词变化。

lines.english: What time do you usually get up in the morning?
lines.chinese: 你早上通常几点起床？
lines.frame: What time do/does 【人】 usually 【动词原形】?
lines.tip: 询问习惯用一般现在时；把 you 换成 she 时，do 要变 does，get 仍用原形。

transfers.english: What time does your brother usually leave home?
transfers.chinese: 你哥哥通常几点出门？

transfers.english: What time do you usually finish work?
transfers.chinese: 你通常几点下班？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: I get up at seven, but my sister gets up half an hour earlier.
lines.chinese: 我七点起床，不过我妹妹早半小时起。
lines.frame: I 【动词原形】, but 【第三人称单数】 【动词加-s】.
lines.tip: I get 与 my sister gets 对照着记；earlier 表示更早。

transfers.english: I drink tea, but my father drinks coffee.
transfers.chinese: 我喝茶，不过我爸爸喝咖啡。

transfers.english: I walk to work, but my friend takes the bus.
transfers.chinese: 我走路上班，不过我朋友坐公交。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: How often do you go to work by bus?
lines.chinese: 你多久坐一次公交上班？
lines.frame: How often do/does 【人】 【动词原形】?
lines.tip: how often 问频率；回答可用 every day、twice a week 等。

transfers.english: How often do you cook at home?
transfers.chinese: 你多久在家做一次饭？

transfers.english: How often does she call her parents?
transfers.chinese: 她多久给父母打一次电话？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Only twice a week because I work from home on the other days.
lines.chinese: 一周只有两次，因为其他几天我在家办公。
lines.frame: 【频率】 because 【完整原因句】.
lines.tip: 这是接着上一个问题的省略式回答；独立说时可补上 I go to work by bus。

transfers.english: Once a month because I don't have much free time.
transfers.chinese: 一个月一次，因为我空闲时间不多。

transfers.english: Almost every day because it's close to home.
transfers.chinese: 几乎每天，因为离家近。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 正在忙什么与提供帮助
scenes.goal: 分清当前活动、习惯，以及礼貌请求。

lines.english: What are you working on at the moment?
lines.chinese: 你现在正忙什么呢？
lines.frame: What am/is/are 【人】 【动词-ing】?
lines.tip: 当前或现阶段正在做的事用 be + V-ing；不是 What do you working on?。

transfers.english: What is she looking for?
transfers.chinese: 她正在找什么？

transfers.english: What are they talking about?
transfers.chinese: 他们正在聊什么？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: I'm trying to find out why this page won't open.
lines.chinese: 我正试着弄清楚这个页面为什么打不开。
lines.frame: I'm trying to find out why 【主语＋谓语】.
lines.tip: try 后接 to V；why 后面保留陈述语序；won't open 在这里表示怎么也打不开。

transfers.english: I'm trying to find out why the bus is late.
transfers.chinese: 我正试着弄清楚公交为什么晚点。

transfers.english: I'm trying to find out where the noise is coming from.
transfers.chinese: 我正试着弄清楚噪声是从哪里来的。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Do you need a hand, or would you rather work on your own?
lines.chinese: 你需要帮忙，还是更想自己做？
lines.frame: Do you need 【帮助】, or would you rather 【动词原形】?
lines.tip: would rather 后接动词原形；on your own 表自己一个人，代词随对象变化。

transfers.english: Do you need a map, or would you rather ask someone?
transfers.chinese: 你需要地图，还是更想找个人问问？

transfers.english: Do you need some advice, or would you rather think about it first?
transfers.chinese: 你需要些建议，还是更想先自己想想？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Could you have a look at this link while I restart the computer?
lines.chinese: 我重启电脑时，你能帮我看看这个链接吗？
lines.frame: Could you 【动词原形】 while I 【动作】?
lines.tip: Could you 在这里是礼貌请求；while 后面是同时进行的另一件事。

transfers.english: Could you watch my bag while I buy a ticket?
transfers.chinese: 我买票的时候，你能帮我看一下包吗？

transfers.english: Could you check the address while I call the driver?
transfers.chinese: 我给司机打电话时，你能核对一下地址吗？

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 找一个可以聊天的地方
scenes.goal: 练 there be、位置表达与选择。

lines.english: Is there a quiet place where we can talk for a moment?
lines.chinese: 有没有一个安静的地方，我们可以聊一会儿？
lines.frame: Is there a 【事物】 where 【主语＋谓语】?
lines.tip: there is 的问句把 is 提到 there 前；where 后说明这个地方能做什么。

transfers.english: Is there a shop where I can buy a charger?
transfers.chinese: 有没有能买充电器的商店？

transfers.english: Is there a room where we can practise?
transfers.chinese: 有没有一个我们可以练习的房间？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: There are a few empty seats in front of the window.
lines.chinese: 窗户前面有几个空座位。
lines.frame: There are a few 【可数复数】 【位置】.
lines.tip: a few 接复数，前面用 there are；empty seats 是形容词加名词。

transfers.english: There are a few useful books on that shelf.
transfers.chinese: 那个架子上有几本有用的书。

transfers.english: There are a few small shops near the station.
transfers.chinese: 车站附近有几家小店。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Which one would you like, the seat on the left or the one by the door?
lines.chinese: 你想坐哪个，左边的座位，还是门边那个？
lines.frame: Which one would you like, 【选项A】 or 【选项B】?
lines.tip: one 代替前面同类的单数名词；两个选项指的都是座位。

transfers.english: Which one would you like, the large cup or the small one?
transfers.chinese: 你想要哪个，大杯还是小杯？

transfers.english: Which one would you like, the morning class or the evening one?
transfers.chinese: 你想上哪个，上午的课还是晚上的课？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: The one on the left looks good because it's away from the door.
lines.chinese: 左边那个看着不错，因为离门口远一些。
lines.frame: 【选择】 looks 【形容词】 because 【原因句】.
lines.tip: looks 在这里表示看起来，后接 good 这样的形容词；because 后说明原因。

transfers.english: The blue one looks better because it's easier to read.
transfers.chinese: 蓝色的那个看起来更好，因为更容易阅读。

transfers.english: The smaller room looks good because it's close to the kitchen.
transfers.chinese: 较小的房间看着不错，因为离厨房近。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 买菜前查数量
scenes.goal: 分清 how much/how many、a little/a few。

lines.english: How much milk have we got left?
lines.chinese: 我们还剩多少牛奶？
lines.frame: How much 【不可数名词】 have/has 【人】 got left?
lines.tip: have got 在这里表示拥有；疑问形式是 have we got；milk 按不可数来问。

transfers.english: How much time have we got left?
transfers.chinese: 我们还剩多少时间？

transfers.english: How much money has she got left?
transfers.chinese: 她还剩多少钱？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Only a little, and we've run out of bread.
lines.chinese: 只剩一点，而且我们的面包也吃完了。
lines.frame: 【数量短答】, and we've run out of 【东西】.
lines.tip: a little 接上文省略了 milk；have run out of 表示用完后的当前结果。 数量短答要与上一问对应：milk 用 a little，pens 等可数复数用 a few。

transfers.english: Only a few, and we've run out of paper.
transfers.chinese: 只剩几支了，而且纸也用完了。

transfers.english: Only a little, and we've run out of coffee.
transfers.chinese: 只剩一点了，而且咖啡也喝完了。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: How many eggs should I add to the shopping list?
lines.chinese: 购物清单上我该加几个鸡蛋？
lines.frame: How many 【可数复数】 should 【人】 【动词原形】?
lines.tip: how many 后接 eggs 这样的复数；should 后 add 用原形。

transfers.english: How many chairs should we put in the room?
transfers.chinese: 我们该在房间里放几把椅子？

transfers.english: How many examples should I include?
transfers.chinese: 我该放几个例子？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: A few should be enough, but let's get some fruit as well.
lines.chinese: 几个应该够了，不过我们再买些水果吧。
lines.frame: 【数量】 should be enough, but let's 【动词原形】.
lines.tip: a few 代指几个鸡蛋；let's 后接原形；fruit 在这里作不可数集合概念。

transfers.english: Ten minutes should be enough, but let's start now.
transfers.chinese: 十分钟应该够，不过我们现在就开始吧。

transfers.english: Two bags should be enough, but let's bring an extra one.
transfers.chinese: 两个包应该够，不过我们多带一个吧。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 点餐与表达偏好
scenes.goal: 礼貌说想吃什么，练 to V、V-ing 与 would rather。

lines.english: What would you like for lunch?
lines.chinese: 午饭你想吃什么？
lines.frame: What would 【人】 like 【用途／时间】?
lines.tip: would like 表礼貌地想要；若接动作，用 would like to + V。

transfers.english: What would you like to drink?
transfers.chinese: 你想喝什么？

transfers.english: What would she like for her birthday?
transfers.chinese: 她生日想要什么？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: I'd like some soup rather than a large meal.
lines.chinese: 我想喝点汤，不想吃一大顿。
lines.frame: I'd like 【名词短语A】 rather than 【名词短语B】.
lines.tip: rather than 连接这里的两种选择；some soup 中 soup 按不可数来用。

transfers.english: I'd like a quiet room rather than a large one.
transfers.chinese: 我想要安静的房间，而不是大房间。

transfers.english: I'd like more time rather than more money.
transfers.chinese: 我想要更多时间，而不是更多钱。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Do you feel like sharing a salad as well?
lines.chinese: 你还想一起分一份沙拉吗？
lines.frame: Do/Does 【人】 feel like 【名词／V-ing】?
lines.tip: feel like 后若接动作，用 V-ing；sharing 表示一起分着吃。

transfers.english: Do you feel like taking a short walk?
transfers.chinese: 你想散一小会儿步吗？

transfers.english: Does she feel like watching a film tonight?
transfers.chinese: 她今晚想看电影吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: That sounds good, but I'd rather not have too much dressing.
lines.chinese: 听着不错，不过我不想放太多沙拉酱。
lines.frame: That sounds 【形容词】, but I'd rather not 【动词原形】.
lines.tip: would rather not + V 表更愿意不做某事；too much 接这里不可数的 dressing。

transfers.english: That sounds fun, but I'd rather not stay out late.
transfers.chinese: 听着有意思，不过我不想在外面待太晚。

transfers.english: That sounds useful, but I'd rather not spend too much money.
transfers.chinese: 听着有用，不过我不想花太多钱。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 邀请与改约
scenes.goal: 接受、婉拒，再提出另一个时间。

lines.english: Would you like to go for a walk after work?
lines.chinese: 下班后你想去散步吗？
lines.frame: Would you like to 【动词原形】 【时间】?
lines.tip: to 后用原形；这是邀请，而不是询问长期爱好。

transfers.english: Would you like to have dinner with us?
transfers.chinese: 你想和我们一起吃晚饭吗？

transfers.english: Would you like to try the new café on Saturday?
transfers.chinese: 周六想去试试那家新咖啡馆吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: I'd love to, but I have to look after my little brother.
lines.chinese: 我很想去，不过我得照看弟弟。
lines.frame: I'd love to, but I have to 【动词原形】.
lines.tip: love to 后省略了上一句的动作；保留 to 是自然的省略答复。

transfers.english: I'd love to, but I have to finish this report.
transfers.chinese: 我很想去，不过我得先写完这份报告。

transfers.english: I'd love to, but I have to get up early tomorrow.
transfers.chinese: 我很想去，不过我明天得早起。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: How about meeting at the weekend instead?
lines.chinese: 那改到周末见面怎么样？
lines.frame: How about 【名词／V-ing】 【时间】?
lines.tip: about 是介词，接动作时用 meeting，不用 meet。

transfers.english: How about taking the train instead?
transfers.chinese: 改坐火车怎么样？

transfers.english: How about a short break before we continue?
transfers.chinese: 继续之前休息一会儿怎么样？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: That sounds like a good idea, and I'm looking forward to seeing you on Saturday.
lines.chinese: 听起来是个好主意，我很期待周六见到你。
lines.frame: That sounds like 【名词短语】, and I'm looking forward to 【名词／V-ing】.
lines.tip: sound like 后接名词短语；look forward to 中的 to 是介词，接 seeing，不是 see。

transfers.english: That sounds like a useful course, and I'm looking forward to joining it.
transfers.chinese: 听起来是门有用的课，我很期待参加。

transfers.english: That sounds like a lovely plan, and I'm looking forward to spending time with you.
transfers.chinese: 听起来安排得很好，我很期待和你一起相处。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 接下来的计划与报平安
scenes.goal: 区分计划、已安排的活动与临时承诺。

lines.english: What are you going to do after you get home?
lines.chinese: 你回家后打算做什么？
lines.frame: What are you going to 【动词原形】 after 【主语＋现在时】?
lines.tip: 主句 be going to 表计划；after 后谈未来时通常仍用现在时。

transfers.english: What are you going to cook after your guests arrive?
transfers.chinese: 客人到后你打算做什么菜？

transfers.english: What are you going to study after you finish this book?
transfers.chinese: 读完这本书后你打算学什么？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: I'm meeting a friend at six, so I need to get ready soon.
lines.chinese: 我六点约了朋友，所以得赶快准备一下。
lines.frame: I'm 【动词-ing】 【未来时间】, so I need to 【动词原形】.
lines.tip: 现在进行时配明确的未来时间，可表达已经安排好的活动。

transfers.english: I'm taking the train at eight, so I need to leave soon.
transfers.chinese: 我八点坐火车，所以得快点出门。

transfers.english: I'm having an interview tomorrow, so I need to prepare tonight.
transfers.chinese: 我明天有面试，所以今晚得准备。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Will you let me know as soon as you get there?
lines.chinese: 你一到那儿就告诉我，好吗？
lines.frame: Will you let me know as soon as 【主语＋现在时】?
lines.tip: as soon as 表一……就……；这里用 get，而不是 will get。

transfers.english: Will you let me know as soon as the meeting ends?
transfers.chinese: 会议一结束你就告诉我，好吗？

transfers.english: Will you let me know as soon as your plan changes?
transfers.chinese: 计划一有变化你就告诉我，好吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Of course, and I'll call you when I'm on my way back.
lines.chinese: 当然，我回来的路上会给你打电话。
lines.frame: I'll 【动词原形】 when 【主语＋现在时】.
lines.tip: I'll 在这里作回应中的承诺；when 从句用 I'm，不用 I'll be。

transfers.english: I'll send you a message when I arrive.
transfers.chinese: 我到了会给你发消息。

transfers.english: I'll explain the problem when we have a few minutes.
transfers.chinese: 我们有几分钟空闲时，我会解释这个问题。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 问路与乘车
scenes.goal: 先礼貌问位置，再确认路线。

lines.english: Excuse me, could you tell me where the nearest bus stop is?
lines.chinese: 打扰一下，能告诉我最近的公交站在哪儿吗？
lines.frame: Could you tell me where 【主语】 is/are?
lines.tip: 嵌入式问句保留陈述语序：where the stop is，不用 where is the stop。

transfers.english: Could you tell me where the nearest cash machine is?
transfers.chinese: 能告诉我最近的取款机在哪儿吗？

transfers.english: Could you tell me when the next class starts?
transfers.chinese: 能告诉我下一节课几点开始吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Go straight ahead and get on the bus outside the station.
lines.chinese: 一直往前走，在车站外面上公交车。
lines.frame: 【动词原形】 and 【动词原形】 【位置】.
lines.tip: 指路常用祈使句；公交车、火车等常用 get on，上小汽车常用 get in。

transfers.english: Go upstairs and wait outside the office.
transfers.chinese: 上楼，在办公室外面等。

transfers.english: Turn left and look for the blue sign.
transfers.chinese: 左转，找蓝色的标志。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Where should I get off if I want to reach the city centre?
lines.chinese: 想去市中心的话，我应该在哪儿下车？
lines.frame: Where should I 【动词原形】 if 【条件句】?
lines.tip: should 后 get 用原形；if 后的条件用 want to + V。

transfers.english: Where should I wait if I arrive early?
transfers.chinese: 如果早到了，我应该在哪儿等？

transfers.english: Where should we meet if it rains?
transfers.chinese: 如果下雨，我们应该在哪儿见？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Get off at the next stop, and the main square will be on your left.
lines.chinese: 下一站下车，主广场就在你左边。
lines.frame: 【祈使句】, and 【主语】 will 【动词原形】.
lines.tip: 前半句指示动作，后半句说明随后会看到的结果或位置。

transfers.english: Open the file, and you'll see the instructions.
transfers.chinese: 打开文件，你就会看到说明。

transfers.english: Follow this road, and the hotel will be on your right.
transfers.chinese: 沿着这条路走，酒店就在右边。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 请求帮忙与回应
scenes.goal: 练 could、would you mind，以及物与人的位置。

lines.english: Could you send me the address and write the time down as well?
lines.chinese: 能把地址发给我，也把时间记下来吗？
lines.frame: Could you send 【人】 【东西】 and 【动作原形】?
lines.tip: send me the address 是给谁什么；and 后 write 与 send 并列。

transfers.english: Could you show me the photo and explain the problem?
transfers.chinese: 能把照片给我看看，再解释一下问题吗？

transfers.english: Could you give her the key and tell her the room number?
transfers.chinese: 能把钥匙给她，再告诉她房间号吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: No problem, but would you mind turning the music off first?
lines.chinese: 没问题，不过你介意先把音乐关掉吗？
lines.frame: Would you mind 【动词-ing】?
lines.tip: 这里请求对方行动；mind 后用 V-ing。若请求自己做某事，常用 Would you mind if I…?。

transfers.english: Would you mind closing the window?
transfers.chinese: 你介意把窗户关上吗？

transfers.english: Would you mind speaking a little more slowly?
transfers.chinese: 你介意说得稍慢一点吗？

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Not at all, and I'll turn it off right now.
lines.chinese: 不介意，我现在就关掉。
lines.frame: Not at all, and I'll 【动词原形】.
lines.tip: 回应 mind 时 Not at all 表不介意、愿意配合；代词 it 放在 turn 与 off 中间。

transfers.english: Not at all, and I'll move my bag.
transfers.chinese: 不介意，我会把包挪开。

transfers.english: Not at all, and I'll write it down for you.
transfers.chinese: 不介意，我会给你写下来。

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Thank you, and I'll send it to you as soon as it's ready.
lines.chinese: 谢谢，准备好后我就发给你。
lines.frame: I'll send 【东西】 to 【人】 as soon as 【主语＋现在时】.
lines.tip: 与 send you the address 对照；这里用 send it to you，指代要让对方明白。

transfers.english: I'll send the receipt to you as soon as I find it.
transfers.chinese: 我一找到收据就发给你。

transfers.english: I'll show the results to you as soon as they're available.
transfers.chinese: 结果一出来我就给你看。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 购物时比较与取舍
scenes.goal: 问价格，比较程度，表达预算限制。

lines.english: How much does this jacket cost compared with the blue one?
lines.chinese: 和蓝色那件相比，这件夹克多少钱？
lines.frame: How much does 【单数事物】 cost compared with 【比较对象】?
lines.tip: does 后 cost 用原形；one 代替前面的同类单数名词。

transfers.english: How much does this course cost compared with the evening one?
transfers.chinese: 和晚间课程比，这门课多少钱？

transfers.english: How much does the train ticket cost compared with the bus ticket?
transfers.chinese: 和公交票比，火车票多少钱？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: It's a bit cheaper, but it's not as warm as the blue one.
lines.chinese: 它便宜一点，不过没蓝色那件暖和。
lines.frame: It's 【比较级】, but it's not as 【形容词原级】 as 【对象】.
lines.tip: a bit 可修饰比较级；as…as 中间用 warm，不用 warmer。

transfers.english: It's faster, but it's not as comfortable as the train.
transfers.chinese: 它更快，不过没火车舒服。

transfers.english: It's smaller, but it's not as expensive as the other room.
transfers.chinese: 它更小，不过没另一个房间贵。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Is the blue one large enough to wear over a sweater at work?
lines.chinese: 蓝色那件够大吗，上班时能套在毛衣外面吗？
lines.frame: Is 【事物】 【形容词】 enough to 【动词原形】?
lines.tip: 形容词放在 enough 前；to wear 说明达到什么用途。

transfers.english: Is this bag big enough to hold my laptop?
transfers.chinese: 这个包够大，装得下我的笔记本电脑吗？

transfers.english: Is the room quiet enough to record a lesson?
transfers.chinese: 这个房间够安静，能录课吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: It should be, but I can't afford to pay for both.
lines.chinese: 应该够，不过两件我都买的话负担不起。
lines.frame: It should be, but I can't afford to 【动词原形】.
lines.tip: should be 后省略了前面已说的状态；afford 可接 to V。

transfers.english: It should be, but I can't afford to wait another week.
transfers.chinese: 应该可以，不过我等不起另一个星期。

transfers.english: It should be, but I can't afford to lose this file.
transfers.chinese: 应该可以，不过这个文件我可丢不起。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 酒店办理入住
scenes.goal: 练拥有、许可与未来时间从句。

lines.english: I'd like to check in, but I can't find my booking number.
lines.chinese: 我想办理入住，可是找不到预订号了。
lines.frame: I'd like to 【动作】, but I can't 【动词原形】.
lines.tip: would like to 表礼貌意愿；can't 后动词用原形。

transfers.english: I'd like to pay, but I can't find my wallet.
transfers.chinese: 我想付款，可是找不到钱包了。

transfers.english: I'd like to join, but I can't open the form.
transfers.chinese: 我想参加，可是打不开表格。

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Have you got a copy of the email on your phone?
lines.chinese: 你手机上有那封邮件的副本吗？
lines.frame: Have/Has 【人】 got 【东西】?
lines.tip: 这里 have got 表拥有；这不是在问‘有没有获得过’的经历。

transfers.english: Have you got a pen I can borrow?
transfers.chinese: 你有没有笔可以借我用一下？

transfers.english: Has she got enough information to decide?
transfers.chinese: 她有没有足够的信息作决定？

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Yes, and am I allowed to leave my bag here before the room is ready?
lines.chinese: 有，另外房间准备好之前，我能把包放在这里吗？
lines.frame: Am/Is/Are 【人】 allowed to 【动词原形】?
lines.tip: be allowed to 用来问许可；before 从句表示房间准备好之前。

transfers.english: Am I allowed to take photos in this room?
transfers.chinese: 我可以在这个房间拍照吗？

transfers.english: Are we allowed to bring our own food?
transfers.chinese: 我们可以自带食物吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Of course, and we'll take care of it until you come back.
lines.chinese: 当然，我们会保管好，等你回来。
lines.frame: We'll 【动作】 until 【主语＋现在时】.
lines.tip: it 指前面的 bag；谈未来时，until 后这里用 come，不用 will come。

transfers.english: We'll keep the room for you until you arrive.
transfers.chinese: 我们会把房间留给你，等你到。

transfers.english: I'll look after your plants until you return.
transfers.chinese: 你回来之前，我会照看你的植物。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 聊一次过去的旅行
scenes.goal: 问过去的经历，继续追问最喜欢的部分。

lines.english: Where did you go on holiday last year?
lines.chinese: 你去年去哪里度假了？
lines.frame: Where did 【人】 【动词原形】 【过去时间】?
lines.tip: did 后用 go，不用 went；last year 是已结束的过去时间。

transfers.english: Where did you study before you moved here?
transfers.chinese: 搬来这里之前，你在哪儿读书？

transfers.english: Where did they stay during the trip?
transfers.chinese: 旅行期间他们住在哪儿？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: I went to a small town where my old friend grew up.
lines.chinese: 我去了一个小镇，我的老朋友就是在那里长大的。
lines.frame: I went to 【地点】 where 【完整句子】.
lines.tip: where 从句修饰地点；went、grew 分别是 go、grow 的过去式。

transfers.english: I visited the school where my mother used to teach.
transfers.chinese: 我参观了妈妈过去教书的学校。

transfers.english: We found a café where we could sit outside.
transfers.chinese: 我们找到一家能坐在室外的咖啡馆。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: What was the best thing about the trip?
lines.chinese: 这趟旅行最棒的是什么？
lines.frame: What was/is the best thing about 【主题】?
lines.tip: 用 be 问评价，不用 did；the best 是最高级。

transfers.english: What was the best thing about your new job?
transfers.chinese: 你的新工作最棒的地方是什么？

transfers.english: What is the best thing about living here?
transfers.chinese: 住在这里最棒的是什么？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Getting to know the local way of life was the best part.
lines.chinese: 最棒的是了解当地人的生活方式。
lines.frame: 【V-ing 短语】 was/is the best part.
lines.tip: Getting to know 整个动名词短语作主语；不要只把开头 getting 当谓语。

transfers.english: Learning to cook with my family was the best part.
transfers.chinese: 最棒的是和家人一起学做饭。

transfers.english: Meeting people from different countries was the best part.
transfers.chinese: 最棒的是认识来自不同国家的人。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 还原一件过去发生的事
scenes.goal: 把当时的背景与后来发生的动作分开。

lines.english: What were you doing last time I called you?
lines.chinese: 上次我给你打电话的时候，你在做什么？
lines.frame: What was/were 【人】 【V-ing】 when/last time 【过去事件】?
lines.tip: were doing 提供当时正在进行的背景；called 是插入的过去事件。

transfers.english: What were you reading when I came in?
transfers.chinese: 我进来时你在读什么？

transfers.english: What was she working on when the power went off?
transfers.chinese: 停电时她正在忙什么？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: My neighbours were playing loud music while I was working at home.
lines.chinese: 我在家工作时，邻居正放着很响的音乐。
lines.frame: 【人】 was/were 【V-ing】 while 【人】 was/were 【V-ing】.
lines.tip: while 连接当时同时进行的两个活动；前后 be 随主语变化。

transfers.english: The children were playing while I was making dinner.
transfers.chinese: 我做晚饭时，孩子们在玩。

transfers.english: She was taking notes while we were discussing the plan.
transfers.chinese: 我们讨论计划时，她在记笔记。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Did you ask them to turn the music off for a moment?
lines.chinese: 你有没有请他们把音乐暂时关一下？
lines.frame: Did 【人】 ask 【人】 to 【动词原形】?
lines.tip: did 后 ask 用原形；ask sb to do 表请某人做某事。

transfers.english: Did you ask him to send you a copy?
transfers.chinese: 你有没有请他发份副本给你？

transfers.english: Did she ask you to help with the bags?
transfers.chinese: 她有没有请你帮忙拿包？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Yes, and they turned it off as soon as they realised I was on the phone.
lines.chinese: 有，他们一知道我在打电话，就把音乐关了。
lines.frame: 【人】 【过去式】 as soon as 【过去事件】.
lines.tip: 这里回忆过去，所以 realised 也用过去式；it 放在 turned 与 off 之间。

transfers.english: She called me as soon as she saw the message.
transfers.chinese: 她一看到消息就给我打了电话。

transfers.english: We left as soon as the rain stopped.
transfers.chinese: 雨一停我们就走了。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 经历、完成与还没做完
scenes.goal: 区分 ever、already、yet、just 的语境。

lines.english: Have you ever taken part in an online class?
lines.chinese: 你参加过线上课程吗？
lines.frame: Have/Has 【人】 ever 【过去分词】?
lines.tip: 问到目前为止的人生经历；take 的过去分词是 taken。

transfers.english: Have you ever travelled on your own?
transfers.chinese: 你独自旅行过吗？

transfers.english: Has she ever worked in a hotel?
transfers.chinese: 她在酒店工作过吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Yes, and I've already learned a lot from a short course.
lines.chinese: 参加过，我已经从一门短课里学到不少东西。
lines.frame: I've already 【过去分词】 【内容】.
lines.tip: already 突出到现在已经发生；这里不附 last year 这样的已结束时间。

transfers.english: I've already sent the address to your phone.
transfers.chinese: 我已经把地址发到你手机上了。

transfers.english: We've already discussed the main problem.
transfers.chinese: 我们已经讨论过主要问题了。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Have you finished all the exercises yet, or are you still working on them?
lines.chinese: 练习都做完了吗，还是还在做？
lines.frame: Have you 【过去分词】 yet, or are you still 【V-ing】?
lines.tip: 前半问当前完成结果，后半问当前过程；them 指复数 exercises。

transfers.english: Have you packed your bag yet, or are you still choosing clothes?
transfers.chinese: 包收拾好了吗，还是还在选衣服？

transfers.english: Have they made a decision yet, or are they still thinking about it?
transfers.chinese: 他们作出决定了吗，还是还在考虑？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Not yet, but I've just worked out how to do the last one.
lines.chinese: 还没有，不过我刚弄懂最后一题怎么做。
lines.frame: Not yet, but I've just 【过去分词】 【内容】.
lines.tip: just 表刚刚；how to do 是‘怎样做’，作 worked out 的内容。

transfers.english: Not yet, but I've just found the information I need.
transfers.chinese: 还没有，不过我刚找到需要的信息。

transfers.english: Not yet, but I've just learned how to use the app.
transfers.chinese: 还没有，不过我刚学会用这个应用。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 学习持续了多久
scenes.goal: 用 for/since 说时长，比较过程与结果。

lines.english: How long have you been learning English on your own?
lines.chinese: 你自己学英语学了多久了？
lines.frame: How long have/has 【人】 been 【V-ing】?
lines.tip: have been learning 强调持续的学习过程；不能省掉 been。

transfers.english: How long have you been waiting here?
transfers.chinese: 你在这里等多久了？

transfers.english: How long has she been working on this project?
transfers.chinese: 她做这个项目做多久了？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: I've been studying for half an hour every day since the start of the month.
lines.chinese: 从这个月初起，我每天学半小时。
lines.frame: I've been 【V-ing】 for 【每次时长】 every day since 【起点】.
lines.tip: 这里 for half an hour 是每天的时长，since 引出这个习惯开始的时间点。

transfers.english: I've been walking for twenty minutes every morning since last week.
transfers.chinese: 从上周起，我每天早上走二十分钟。

transfers.english: I've been reading for an hour every evening since I joined the class.
transfers.chinese: 参加这门课以来，我每天晚上读一小时。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Have you noticed any changes in the way you speak?
lines.chinese: 你有没有发现自己的说话方式有些变化？
lines.frame: Have you noticed any changes in the way 【主语＋谓语】?
lines.tip: 完成时询问到现在观察到的变化；the way you speak 指你的说话方式，整个 in 短语说明变化出现在哪方面。

transfers.english: Have you noticed any changes in the way you sleep?
transfers.chinese: 你有没有发现自己的睡眠方式有些变化？

transfers.english: Have you noticed any changes in the way the team works?
transfers.chinese: 你有没有发现团队工作方式有些变化？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Yes, and I've become more confident because I practise a little every day.
lines.chinese: 有，我更有信心了，因为每天都练一点。
lines.frame: I've become 【形容词／比较级】 because 【日常原因】.
lines.tip: become 的过去分词仍是 become；完成时说变化，because 后用现在时说日常习惯。

transfers.english: I've become more organised because I plan my week.
transfers.chinese: 我更有条理了，因为我会安排一周的事情。

transfers.english: I've become less nervous because I know what to expect.
transfers.chinese: 我没那么紧张了，因为我知道接下来会怎样。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 过去习惯与现在习惯
scenes.goal: 分清 used to、be used to 和 get used to。

lines.english: Did you use to stay up late when you were at university?
lines.chinese: 你上大学时以前经常熬夜吗？
lines.frame: Did 【人】 use to 【动词原形】?
lines.tip: 常规书写中，did 后用 use to；肯定句才是 used to + V。

transfers.english: Did you use to play football after school?
transfers.chinese: 你以前放学后经常踢足球吗？

transfers.english: Did she use to live near the sea?
transfers.chinese: 她以前住在海边吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: I used to, but I'm used to getting up early these days.
lines.chinese: 以前会，不过这些天我习惯早起了。
lines.frame: I used to 【V】, but I'm used to 【V-ing】 now.
lines.tip: 前一个 used to 是过去的习惯；后一个 be used to 中的 to 是介词，后接 V-ing。

transfers.english: I used to drive, but I'm used to taking the train now.
transfers.chinese: 以前我开车，不过现在习惯坐火车了。

transfers.english: I used to eat out, but I'm used to cooking at home now.
transfers.chinese: 以前我在外面吃，不过现在习惯在家做饭了。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Was it difficult to get used to the new routine?
lines.chinese: 习惯新的作息难吗？
lines.frame: Was/Is it 【形容词】 to get used to 【名词／V-ing】?
lines.tip: get used to 强调逐渐适应；it 先占据主语位置，具体内容是后面的不定式。

phraseUses.surface: get used to the new routine

transfers.english: Was it difficult to get used to working at night?
transfers.chinese: 习惯夜间工作难吗？

transfers.english: Is it easy to get used to the weather here?
transfers.chinese: 习惯这里的天气容易吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: At first it was, but I got better at going to bed on time.
lines.chinese: 起初挺难，不过后来我更能按时上床了。
lines.frame: At first it was, but I got better at 【V-ing】.
lines.tip: at 后接动作时用 V-ing；it was 省略了前面问题里的 difficult。

transfers.english: At first it was, but I got better at asking for help.
transfers.chinese: 起初挺难，不过后来我更会开口求助了。

transfers.english: At first it was, but I got better at planning my day.
transfers.chinese: 起初挺难，不过后来我更会安排一天的事情了。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 谈困难与给建议
scenes.goal: 表达做某事很难，提出可操作的办法。

lines.english: I find it difficult to concentrate on long conversations.
lines.chinese: 我觉得集中注意力听长对话挺难。
lines.frame: I find it 【形容词】 to 【动词原形】.
lines.tip: it 作形式宾语，具体觉得困难的事放在 to 后；concentrate on 后接关注对象。

transfers.english: I find it hard to remember people's names.
transfers.chinese: 我觉得记人名很难。

transfers.english: I find it useful to read the instructions first.
transfers.chinese: 我觉得先读说明很有用。

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Why not start with a short conversation and focus on one pattern at a time?
lines.chinese: 为什么不先从一段短对话开始，一次专注一个句式呢？
lines.frame: Why not 【动词原形】 and 【动词原形】?
lines.tip: Why not 后不加 to；start 与 focus 都是并列的原形。

transfers.english: Why not take a short break and try again?
transfers.chinese: 为什么不稍微休息一下，再试一次呢？

transfers.english: Why not write the main points down and check them later?
transfers.chinese: 为什么不先记下要点，过后再核对呢？

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Will I be able to deal with faster speech if I practise like that?
lines.chinese: 如果这样练，我能应付更快的语速吗？
lines.frame: Will 【人】 be able to 【动词原形】 if 【条件】?
lines.tip: will 后用 be；be able to 后再接动词原形，不是 will can。

transfers.english: Will I be able to finish in time if I start now?
transfers.chinese: 如果现在开始，我能及时完成吗？

transfers.english: Will we be able to save more if we cook at home?
transfers.chinese: 如果在家做饭，我们能多存些钱吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: You should improve over time, but you ought to practise speaking as well.
lines.chinese: 你应该会逐渐进步，不过也该练练开口说。
lines.frame: 【人】 should 【V】, but 【人】 ought to 【V】 as well.
lines.tip: should 后直接接原形；ought 后有 to。前半是预期，后半给建议。

transfers.english: It should get easier, but you ought to ask questions as well.
transfers.chinese: 它应该会变容易，不过你也该主动提问。

transfers.english: You should feel more prepared, but you ought to check the details as well.
transfers.chinese: 你应该会更有准备，不过也该核对细节。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 下雨时的备用方案
scenes.goal: 练 if、unless、as long as 和 in case 的区别。

lines.english: What will we do if it rains on Monday?
lines.chinese: 如果周一下雨，我们怎么办？
lines.frame: What will 【人】 do if 【主语＋现在时】?
lines.tip: 主句问将来安排，if 条件从句这里用 rains，不用 will rain。

transfers.english: What will we do if the train is late?
transfers.chinese: 如果火车晚点，我们怎么办？

transfers.english: What will she do if the shop is closed?
transfers.chinese: 如果店关门了，她怎么办？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: We'll stay in unless the weather gets better.
lines.chinese: 除非天气好转，不然我们就待在室内。
lines.frame: 【主语】 will 【V】 unless 【主语＋现在时】.
lines.tip: unless 在这里接近 if…not；注意它已经包含否定条件。

transfers.english: We'll take the bus unless someone can drive us.
transfers.chinese: 除非有人能开车送我们，不然我们就坐公交。

transfers.english: I'll keep the old phone unless I find a better one.
transfers.chinese: 除非找到更好的，不然我就继续用旧手机。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Can we go out as long as we're back before dark?
lines.chinese: 只要天黑前回来，我们能出去吗？
lines.frame: Can 【人】 【V】 as long as 【条件】?
lines.tip: as long as 在这里是只要，并不是在问时间有多长。

transfers.english: Can I borrow the book as long as I return it tomorrow?
transfers.chinese: 只要明天归还，我能借这本书吗？

transfers.english: Can we use the room as long as we keep it clean?
transfers.chinese: 只要保持干净，我们能用这个房间吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Yes, but take a jacket in case it gets cold.
lines.chinese: 能，不过带件外套，以防变冷。
lines.frame: 【祈使句】 in case 【可能出现的情况】.
lines.tip: 这里先带外套以防降温；in case 不等同于等到降温才行动的 if。

transfers.english: Save a copy in case the file gets lost.
transfers.chinese: 保存一个副本，以防文件丢失。

transfers.english: Write the address down in case your phone runs out of power.
transfers.chinese: 把地址写下来，以防手机没电。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 假设有更多自己的时间
scenes.goal: 练不现实的愿望、假设与委婉建议。

lines.english: I wish I had more time for myself, but I keep taking on more work.
lines.chinese: 我真希望多些自己的时间，可我总是接更多工作。
lines.frame: I wish 【主语＋过去形式】, but I keep 【V-ing】.
lines.tip: wish 后用 had 表现在与现实有距离的愿望；这里不是在叙述曾经拥有。

transfers.english: I wish I lived closer, but I can't move right now.
transfers.chinese: 我真希望住得近一点，可我现在没法搬。

transfers.english: I wish I knew the answer, but I need to check first.
transfers.chinese: 我真希望知道答案，可我需要先查一下。

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: If I were you, I'd take up a hobby rather than add more work.
lines.chinese: 如果我是你，我会培养个爱好，而不是再增加工作。
lines.frame: If I were you, I'd 【V】 rather than 【V】.
lines.tip: I'd 在这里是 I would；假设建议用 were，rather than 前后的动作保持平行。

transfers.english: If I were you, I'd ask for help rather than do everything alone.
transfers.chinese: 如果我是你，我会求助，而不是全都一个人做。

transfers.english: If I were you, I'd check the facts rather than guess.
transfers.chinese: 如果我是你，我会核对事实，而不是猜。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Would it make a difference if I turned my phone off for an hour?
lines.chinese: 如果我把手机关一小时，会有帮助吗？
lines.frame: Would it 【V】 if 【主语＋过去形式】?
lines.tip: 这里 turned 配合假设，不是在直接断言已经关过手机。

transfers.english: Would it help if we started a little earlier?
transfers.chinese: 如果早一点开始，会有帮助吗？

transfers.english: Would it be easier if I showed you an example?
transfers.chinese: 如果我给你看个例子，会更容易吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: It might, and you could use that time to do something you really enjoy.
lines.chinese: 可能有用，你也可以用那段时间做些自己真正喜欢的事。
lines.frame: It might, and you could use 【资源】 to 【动作】.
lines.tip: It might 省略前面的问题内容；something 后的 you really enjoy 是省略了宾语关系词的定语从句。

transfers.english: It might, and you could use the break to clear your head.
transfers.chinese: 可能有用，你也可以用这次休息理清思路。

transfers.english: It might, and we could use the space to store our bags.
transfers.chinese: 可能有用，我们也可以利用那个空间放包。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 照片丢失后的复盘
scenes.goal: 解释更早发生的事，再谈过去的假设。

lines.english: Why didn't you back up the photos before you changed phones?
lines.chinese: 换手机之前，你为什么没备份照片？
lines.frame: Why didn't 【人】 【动词原形】 before 【过去事件】?
lines.tip: didn't 后用 back，不用 backed；这类问法可能有追问或责备语气，要注意关系。

transfers.english: Why didn't you save the file before you closed the app?
transfers.chinese: 关闭应用前，你为什么没保存文件？

transfers.english: Why didn't she check the address before she left?
transfers.chinese: 出发前，她为什么没核对地址？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: I thought I had saved them, but in fact I'd left the only copy on the old phone.
lines.chinese: 我以为保存好了，可其实唯一的副本还在旧手机上。
lines.frame: I thought I had 【过去分词】, but in fact I'd 【过去分词】.
lines.tip: had saved 表比当时更早的动作；I'd left 中 'd = had，因为后接 left 这个过去分词。

transfers.english: I thought I had booked a room, but in fact I'd booked a table.
transfers.chinese: 我以为订了房间，可其实订的是餐桌。

transfers.english: I thought I had sent the message, but in fact I'd only saved it.
transfers.chinese: 我以为消息发出去了，可其实只是保存了。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: If we had backed them up, we wouldn't have lost them.
lines.chinese: 如果当时我们备份过，就不会丢了。
lines.frame: If 【人】 had 【过去分词】, 【人】 would/wouldn't have 【过去分词】.
lines.tip: 对已发生的过去作反事实假设；这里说过去并未备份。用 we 复盘共同经历，可以少一点指责感。

transfers.english: If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.
transfers.chinese: 如果早点走，我们就不会误车了。

transfers.english: If I had checked the size, I wouldn't have bought the wrong one.
transfers.chinese: 如果检查过尺寸，我就不会买错了。

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: I know, and I'll make sure I save a copy in the future.
lines.chinese: 我知道，以后我会确保留一份副本。
lines.frame: I'll make sure 【主语＋谓语】 【将来时间】.
lines.tip: make sure 后接要确保的完整内容；这里 save 描述要执行的做法。

transfers.english: I'll make sure I bring the right documents next time.
transfers.chinese: 下次我会确保带对材料。

transfers.english: We'll make sure everyone knows the meeting time.
transfers.chinese: 我们会确保每个人都知道开会时间。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 报告进度与工作分工
scenes.goal: 练被动表达、负责什么和将来完成。

lines.english: Is the report being checked at the moment?
lines.chinese: 报告现在正在核对吗？
lines.frame: Is/Are 【事物】 being 【过去分词】?
lines.tip: 现在进行被动：is being checked；关注报告正在接受什么处理。

transfers.english: Is the room being cleaned right now?
transfers.chinese: 房间现在正在打扫吗？

transfers.english: Are the tickets being sent out today?
transfers.chinese: 票今天正在发出吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Yes, and it must be sent to everyone by the end of the day.
lines.chinese: 是的，而且必须在今天结束前发给所有人。
lines.frame: 【事物】 must/can/should be 【过去分词】 【截止时间】.
lines.tip: must 后先接 be，再接 sent；不能用 must sent。

phraseUses.surface: by the end of the day

transfers.english: The form must be signed before Friday.
transfers.chinese: 表格必须在周五前签好。

transfers.english: The problem can be solved without replacing the whole system.
transfers.chinese: 这个问题不必更换整个系统就能解决。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Who is in charge of putting all the information together?
lines.chinese: 谁负责把所有信息整理到一起？
lines.frame: Who is in charge of 【名词／V-ing】?
lines.tip: of 是介词，后接 putting；put…together 表整理、组合。

transfers.english: Who is in charge of organising the trip?
transfers.chinese: 谁负责组织这次旅行？

transfers.english: Who is in charge of checking the final list?
transfers.chinese: 谁负责核对最终名单？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: I am, and by the time you come back, I'll have finished the final part.
lines.chinese: 我负责；等你回来时，我就已经完成最后一部分了。
lines.frame: By the time 【主语＋现在时】, 【人】 will have 【过去分词】.
lines.tip: 主句 will have finished 表到未来那时已经完成；时间从句仍用 come。

transfers.english: By the time you arrive, I'll have cooked dinner.
transfers.chinese: 等你到的时候，我就已经做好晚饭了。

transfers.english: By the time the shop opens, we'll have checked all the prices.
transfers.chinese: 等店开门时，我们就已经核对好所有价格了。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 转述别人说的话
scenes.goal: 把听到的计划说清楚，再追问准备事项。

lines.english: What did the manager say about the plan for next week?
lines.chinese: 经理说下周的计划是什么？
lines.frame: What did 【人】 say about 【主题】?
lines.tip: did 后 say 用原形；say 强调说的内容，tell 常需要接告诉谁。

transfers.english: What did the teacher say about the homework?
transfers.chinese: 老师怎么说作业的事？

transfers.english: What did your friend say about the new place?
transfers.chinese: 你朋友怎么评价新地方？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: She said that we'd start with the easier part and work together.
lines.chinese: 她说我们会从较容易的部分开始，一起做。
lines.frame: 【人】 said that 【人】 would 【动词原形】.
lines.tip: we'd 在这里是 we would，因为后面是 start；从过去视角转述接下来的计划。

transfers.english: He said that he'd call after dinner.
transfers.chinese: 他说晚饭后会打电话。

transfers.english: They said that they'd send us the details.
transfers.chinese: 他们说会把细节发给我们。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Did she tell you whether we need to prepare anything else?
lines.chinese: 她有没有告诉你，我们是否还需要准备别的东西？
lines.frame: Did 【人】 tell 【人】 whether 【主语＋谓语】?
lines.tip: tell 后先接人；whether 引出要确认的内容，从句不再做 need we 这种倒装。

transfers.english: Did he tell you whether the shop is open?
transfers.chinese: 他有没有告诉你店是否开着？

transfers.english: Did they tell her whether she needs a ticket?
transfers.chinese: 他们有没有告诉她是否需要票？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: She asked us to make sure we knew how to use the new system.
lines.chinese: 她让我们确保知道怎么使用新系统。
lines.frame: 【人】 asked 【人】 to make sure 【完整内容】.
lines.tip: ask sb to V 表要求或请某人做；know how to V 表知道怎么做。knew 呼应这里的过去转述。

transfers.english: He asked me to make sure everyone had the address.
transfers.chinese: 他让我确保每个人都有地址。

transfers.english: She asked us to make sure we could open the file.
transfers.chinese: 她让我们确保能打开文件。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 这是谁的东西
scenes.goal: 练 whose、who 和省略宾语关系词的定语从句。

lines.english: Whose bag is this, and who left it in the living room?
lines.chinese: 这是谁的包，又是谁把它放在客厅的？
lines.frame: Whose 【名词】 is this, and who 【过去式】?
lines.tip: whose 问归属，who 问人；后半 who 本身作主语，不加 did。

transfers.english: Whose phone is this, and who found it?
transfers.chinese: 这是谁的手机，又是谁找到的？

transfers.english: Whose idea was it, and who agreed to it?
transfers.chinese: 这是谁的主意，又是谁同意的？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: It's the bag that belongs to the friend who helped us move.
lines.chinese: 这是那个帮我们搬家的朋友的包。
lines.frame: It's the 【事物】 that 【谓语】 the 【人】 who 【谓语】.
lines.tip: that 修饰 bag，who 修饰 friend；两个关系词在各自从句里作主语，不能直接删掉。

transfers.english: It's the book that belongs to the teacher who called you.
transfers.chinese: 这是给你打电话那位老师的书。

transfers.english: It's the key that opens the room where we keep the boxes.
transfers.chinese: 这是打开我们存箱子那个房间的钥匙。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Is that the friend whose sister works with you?
lines.chinese: 就是那个姐姐和你一起工作的朋友吗？
lines.frame: Is that the 【人】 whose 【名词】 【谓语】?
lines.tip: whose 在关系从句中表示所属，相当于那位朋友的 sister。

transfers.english: Is that the student whose phone was lost?
transfers.chinese: 就是那个丢了手机的学生吗？

transfers.english: Is that the neighbour whose dog you look after?
transfers.chinese: 就是那个你帮忙照看狗的邻居吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Yes, and the book I borrowed is in the bag as well.
lines.chinese: 是的，而且我借的那本书也在包里。
lines.frame: The 【名词】 (that/which) 【人＋谓语】 is 【位置】.
lines.tip: I borrowed 修饰 book；被省略的关系词在从句里作宾语，所以可以省略。

transfers.english: The message you sent is on my phone.
transfers.chinese: 你发的那条消息在我手机上。

transfers.english: The chair we bought is in the kitchen.
transfers.chinese: 我们买的那把椅子在厨房里。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 说明原因、让步与目的
scenes.goal: 让一段解释同时说清为什么、尽管什么和为了什么。

lines.english: Why are you leaving early instead of staying for the whole meeting?
lines.chinese: 你为什么要提前走，不把整场会开完呢？
lines.frame: Why are you 【V-ing】 instead of 【V-ing】?
lines.tip: instead of 后接名词或 V-ing；前后两个动作在这里保持同类形式。

transfers.english: Why are you taking the bus instead of driving?
transfers.chinese: 你为什么坐公交而不开车？

transfers.english: Why is she working at home instead of coming to the office?
transfers.chinese: 她为什么在家办公，而不到办公室来？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Because I have to pick my daughter up, even though I'd like to stay.
lines.chinese: 因为我得接女儿，虽然我也想留下来。
lines.frame: Because 【原因句】, even though 【让步句】.
lines.tip: 这是回答 why 的省略式话轮；pick sb up 表去接人；even though 后接完整句。

transfers.english: Because I have to catch a train, even though I'd like to talk longer.
transfers.chinese: 因为我得赶火车，虽然我也想多聊一会儿。

transfers.english: Because she needs some rest, even though she'd like to join us.
transfers.chinese: 因为她需要休息，虽然她也想参加。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Could you still send us your notes so that we can follow the discussion?
lines.chinese: 你还是能把笔记发给我们，好让我们跟上讨论吗？
lines.frame: Could you still 【动词原形】 so that 【目的完整句】?
lines.tip: still 承接前面提前离开的情况；so that 后接完整目的句。

transfers.english: Could you still call her so that she can prepare for the trip?
transfers.chinese: 你还是能给她打个电话，好让她准备旅行吗？

transfers.english: Could you still come early so that we can finish before lunch?
transfers.chinese: 你还是能早点来，好让我们午饭前完成吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Of course, and I'll keep them short in order to make them easy to use.
lines.chinese: 当然，我会写得简短些，让它们容易使用。
lines.frame: I'll keep 【对象】 【形容词】 in order to make 【对象】 【形容词】.
lines.tip: keep them short 和 make them easy 都有宾语加补充说明；them 指复数 notes。

transfers.english: I'll keep the message simple in order to make it clear.
transfers.chinese: 我会把消息写得简单些，让它清楚明白。

transfers.english: We'll keep the bags light in order to make them easy to carry.
transfers.chinese: 我们会让包轻一点，方便携带。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 没听清时继续聊下去
scenes.goal: 请求重复、确认模糊词，再用自己的话核实。

lines.english: Could you say that again, a little more slowly?
lines.chinese: 你能再说一遍，稍微慢一点吗？
lines.frame: Could you 【动词原形】 a little more 【副词】?
lines.tip: 请求调整说话方式；用 slowly 修饰 say，而不是单用形容词 slow。

transfers.english: Could you explain that again, a little more clearly?
transfers.chinese: 你能再解释一遍，稍微清楚一点吗？

transfers.english: Could you speak a little more quietly?
transfers.chinese: 你能稍微轻一点说吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: I mean we'll get back to you soon.
lines.chinese: 我的意思是，我们很快会再联系你。
lines.frame: I mean 【完整内容】.
lines.tip: I mean 用来澄清刚才的意思；get back to you 是稍后再回复你，作为补充搭配理解。

transfers.english: I mean we can change the date, not cancel the trip.
transfers.chinese: 我的意思是可以改日期，不是取消旅行。

transfers.english: I mean you only need to finish the first part today.
transfers.chinese: 我的意思是你今天只需要完成第一部分。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: For example, do you mean today or later this week?
lines.chinese: 比如，你指的是今天，还是本周晚些时候？
lines.frame: Do you mean 【选项A】 or 【选项B】?
lines.tip: 用具体选项核实 soon、later 等模糊表达，不必靠猜。

transfers.english: Do you mean the room upstairs or the one next door?
transfers.chinese: 你指楼上的房间，还是隔壁那个？

transfers.english: Do you mean before lunch or after the meeting?
transfers.chinese: 你指午饭前，还是开会后？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: In other words, we'll reply by Friday, and I'll write that down for you.
lines.chinese: 换句话说，我们最晚周五回复，我会给你写下来。
lines.frame: In other words, 【完整内容】, and I'll 【动作】.
lines.tip: by Friday 表最晚周五；write that down 中代词放在动词与小品词之间。

transfers.english: In other words, the price includes breakfast, and I'll confirm that by email.
transfers.chinese: 换句话说，价格含早餐，我会用邮件确认。

transfers.english: In other words, we can start tomorrow, and I'll send you the details.
transfers.chinese: 换句话说，我们明天可以开始，我会把细节发给你。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 不确定时怎样表达
scenes.goal: 区分猜测、强推断与稳妥的下一步。

lines.english: Do you think he's still on the phone?
lines.chinese: 你觉得他还在打电话吗？
lines.frame: Do you think 【主语＋谓语】?
lines.tip: think 后直接接内容；he's 在这里是 he is，不是 he has。

transfers.english: Do you think she's still at work?
transfers.chinese: 你觉得她还在上班吗？

transfers.english: Do you think they know about the change?
transfers.chinese: 你觉得他们知道这个变化吗？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: He might be, but I guess it depends on how busy he is.
lines.chinese: 可能吧，不过我想这得看他有多忙。
lines.frame: 【人】 might be, but I guess it depends on 【内容】.
lines.tip: might be 省略已知状态；how busy he is 保持陈述语序。

phraseUses.surface: depends on how busy he is

transfers.english: She might be, but I guess it depends on when the meeting ends.
transfers.chinese: 可能吧，不过我想这得看会议何时结束。

transfers.english: They might be, but I guess it depends on how much time they have.
transfers.chinese: 可能吧，不过我想这得看他们有多少时间。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: His office light is off, so he must have gone home.
lines.chinese: 他办公室灯关了，所以他应该已经回家了。
lines.frame: 【线索】, so 【人】 must have 【过去分词】.
lines.tip: must have gone 是依据迹象推测过去发生了什么，不是‘必须回过家’。

transfers.english: Her car isn't here, so she must have left already.
transfers.chinese: 她的车不在这里，所以她应该已经走了。

transfers.english: The floor is wet, so someone must have cleaned it.
transfers.chinese: 地面湿着，所以应该有人打扫过。

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Not necessarily, but we'd better leave a message in case he's out.
lines.chinese: 也不一定，不过我们最好留个消息，以防他出去了。
lines.frame: Not necessarily, but we'd better 【动词原形】 in case 【情况】.
lines.tip: we'd better = we had better；better 后不加 to。这个建议比普通 should 更有提醒意味。

transfers.english: Not necessarily, but we'd better check before we pay.
transfers.chinese: 也不一定，不过付款前我们最好核实一下。

transfers.english: Not necessarily, but we'd better bring a spare key.
transfers.chinese: 也不一定，不过我们最好带把备用钥匙。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 表达担心与给予支持
scenes.goal: 说感受、给对方空间，并表达互相支持。

lines.english: You seem worried about something, and I'm here if you want to talk.
lines.chinese: 你好像在担心什么，想聊的话我在。
lines.frame: You seem 【形容词】, and I'm here if you want to 【V】.
lines.tip: seem 后接形容词描述感受；if you want to 给对方选择的空间。

transfers.english: You seem tired, and I can help if you want to rest.
transfers.chinese: 你好像累了，想休息的话我可以帮忙。

transfers.english: You seem unsure, and we can check if you want to be certain.
transfers.chinese: 你好像不太确定，想确认的话我们可以查一查。

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: I'm afraid I'll make a mistake when I speak in public.
lines.chinese: 我怕当众说话时犯错。
lines.frame: I'm afraid 【完整内容】 when 【情境】.
lines.tip: 这里 afraid 是担心，不只是礼貌拒绝；when 从句用现在时。

transfers.english: I'm afraid I'll forget the words when I get nervous.
transfers.chinese: 我怕一紧张就忘词。

transfers.english: I'm afraid they'll misunderstand me when I explain the change.
transfers.chinese: 我怕解释变化时他们会误解我。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: Making mistakes is part of learning, and we can help each other.
lines.chinese: 犯错是学习的一部分，我们可以互相帮忙。
lines.frame: 【V-ing 短语】 is 【名词短语】, and we can 【V】 each other.
lines.tip: Making mistakes 整体作主语；each other 表互相。复数 mistakes 不再用 a。

transfers.english: Asking questions is part of learning, and we can support each other.
transfers.chinese: 提问是学习的一部分，我们可以互相支持。

transfers.english: Sharing information is part of teamwork, and we can learn from each other.
transfers.chinese: 分享信息是合作的一部分，我们可以互相学习。

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: What a difference it makes to know that someone cares about my progress!
lines.chinese: 知道有人关心我的进步，带来的感受真不一样！
lines.frame: What a difference it makes to 【V】!
lines.tip: What + a + 名词构成感叹；to know 说明是什么带来影响，that 后是知道的内容。

transfers.english: What a difference it makes to have clear instructions!
transfers.chinese: 有清楚的说明，带来的帮助真不一样！

transfers.english: What a difference it makes to work with people you trust!
transfers.chinese: 和信任的人共事，感受真不一样！

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 今晚怎么安排
scenes.goal: 问偏好、给选择，再作决定。

lines.english: Would you rather go out or stay in tonight?
lines.chinese: 你今晚更想出去，还是待在家里？
lines.frame: Would you rather 【V】 or 【V】?
lines.tip: rather 后两项都用动词原形，不能加 to。

transfers.english: Would you rather cook or order something?
transfers.chinese: 你更想做饭，还是点些吃的？

transfers.english: Would she rather call or send a message?
transfers.chinese: 她更想打电话，还是发消息？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: I'd rather stay in because I'm a bit tired.
lines.chinese: 我更想待在家里，因为有点累。
lines.frame: I'd rather 【V】 because 【原因句】.
lines.tip: I'd 在这里是 I would；because 后接完整原因。

transfers.english: I'd rather walk because it's not far.
transfers.chinese: 我更想走路，因为不远。

transfers.english: I'd rather start early because I have plans later.
transfers.chinese: 我更想早点开始，因为之后有安排。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: We can either watch a film or listen to music.
lines.chinese: 我们可以看电影，也可以听音乐，选一个。
lines.frame: We can either 【V】 or 【V】.
lines.tip: either…or… 给两个选择；watch 与 listen 共享 can，保持原形。

transfers.english: We can either meet outside or wait in the café.
transfers.chinese: 我们可以在外面碰面，也可以在咖啡馆里等。

transfers.english: You can either save the file or print a copy.
transfers.chinese: 你可以保存文件，也可以打印一份。

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Neither sounds bad, but I'd prefer a film rather than music tonight.
lines.chinese: 两个都不错，不过今晚我更想看电影，而不是听音乐。
lines.frame: Neither sounds 【形容词】, but I'd prefer 【A】 rather than 【B】.
lines.tip: Neither sounds bad 说两项都不糟；prefer 后这里接名词，两项保持同类形式。

transfers.english: Neither looks bad, but I'd prefer the smaller one rather than the larger one.
transfers.chinese: 两个看着都不错，不过我更想要小的那个，而不是大的。

transfers.english: Neither seems difficult, but I'd prefer the first task rather than the second one.
transfers.chinese: 两个看着都不难，不过我更想做第一项，而不是第二项。

lines.speaker: B

scenes.title: 比较两个学习工具
scenes.goal: 表达意见、补充考虑因素，并确认共同结论。

lines.english: What's your point of view on the two options we've discussed?
lines.chinese: 关于我们讨论的这两个选项，你怎么看？
lines.frame: What's your point of view on 【主题】?
lines.tip: we've discussed 修饰 options，省略了作宾语的关系词；这句比 What do you think…? 稍正式。

transfers.english: What's your point of view on working from home?
transfers.chinese: 你怎么看在家办公？

transfers.english: What's your point of view on the plan we made yesterday?
transfers.chinese: 你怎么看我们昨天作出的计划？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: I agree with you about the price, but we need to take quality into account as well.
lines.chinese: 价格方面我同意你，不过我们也得考虑质量。
lines.frame: I agree with 【人】 about 【方面】, but we need to 【V】.
lines.tip: agree with 人表示同意其意见；take…into account 把因素纳入考虑。

transfers.english: I agree with her about the location, but we need to consider the cost.
transfers.chinese: 地点方面我同意她，不过我们需要考虑费用。

transfers.english: I agree with you about the speed, but we need to check the accuracy.
transfers.chinese: 速度方面我同意你，不过我们需要检查准确性。

lines.speaker: B

lines.english: What matters most is whether we'll use it every day, isn't it?
lines.chinese: 最重要的是我们会不会每天用，对吧？
lines.frame: What 【谓语】 is whether 【完整内容】, isn't it?
lines.tip: What matters most 整体作主语；主句是 is，附加问句用 isn't it。

transfers.english: What matters most is whether we can keep doing it, isn't it?
transfers.chinese: 最重要的是我们能不能坚持做，对吧？

transfers.english: What matters most is whether everyone understands, isn't it?
transfers.chinese: 最重要的是大家是否理解，对吧？

lines.speaker: A

lines.english: Exactly, and the simpler one is not only cheaper but also easier to use.
lines.chinese: 没错，而且简单的那个不仅更便宜，也更容易用。
lines.frame: 【事物】 is not only 【形容词A】 but also 【形容词B】.
lines.tip: not only…but also… 两边这里都是形容词性成分；the simpler one 代指更简单的那个工具。

transfers.english: The new route is not only shorter but also safer.
transfers.chinese: 新路线不仅更短，也更安全。

transfers.english: This guide is not only clear but also easy to follow.
transfers.chinese: 这份指南不仅清楚，也容易照着做。

lines.speaker: B

tools.note: 开场；下午可换 Good afternoon。
普通问候；根据关系决定回答的详略。
简短回答近况；pretty 在这里是相当，不是漂亮。
把同一个问题递回去。

tools.english: Let me think for a moment.
tools.note: 给自己一点组织语言的时间。
保留判断，不必硬猜。
坦率说不知道；服务场景可再补一句 I'll check。
后面可以补 on + 名词，或具体说明条件。
表示倾向于肯定，不等于百分之百确定。

tools.chinese: 这说得通／我明白这个道理了。
tools.note: 回应对方的解释。

tools.english: Sorry, I mean Friday, not Thursday.
tools.chinese: 不好意思，我是说周五，不是周四。
tools.note: 改口时给出正确内容；根据实际情况换日期。

tools.english: Could you give me an example?
tools.note: 不清楚抽象解释时，请对方具体化。
偏随意的口语；正式服务场景可用 One moment, please。
这里是许可或鼓励继续，不是指路的直走。

tools.english: By the way, how was your weekend?
tools.chinese: 对了，你周末过得怎么样？
tools.note: 轻轻转向一个相关新话题。
接受提议；sounds 后这里接形容词 good。
回应坏消息、表示关心。
回应感谢。
for 后接感谢的原因。
结束交谈，也可按情境换 tomorrow 等。
